facts.clause: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.
Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies.
Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.
It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits.

This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.
Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire.
Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters.
